d: Are you interested in being part of an HR organization that operates as a business, starts with our internal customers and works backward to deliver meaningful solutions? Are you passionate about changing employees' lives for the better?

The HR Business Partner (Generalist) is a strategic people operations role that drives business results through trusted partnerships with business leaders while staying close to employees of all levels. This position balances strategic insight with hands-on execution, managing complex employee matters, driving initiatives for leadership capabilities on performance and talent, and improving organizational culture to enhance the employee experience.
If this sounds exciting to you, then consider joining us as an HR Business Partner, in our KSA central team based out of Riyadh. This role will be based out of one of our Riyadh-based warehouses.
Important: This strategic HR partner role is an individual contributor (IC) role that will NOT be managing or leading others.
Lead country-wide feedback strategies including data reviews, roundtables, and pulse mechanisms
Navigate complex situations using sound judgment while balancing employee advocacy, compliance, and business impact
Implement recognition programs and champion inclusion and belonging initiatives
Serve as trusted advisor to leaders on sensitive people issues and complex decision-making
Use data analytics to inform people decisions and identify root causes of organizational issues
Support organizational change and transformation initiatives
Drive standard work excellence and ensure process consistency across the organization
Escalate structural, cultural, or systemic risks that impact the population
You would be working directly with the country HR leader for the Amazon Customer Fulfilment business in Saudi Arabia, as well as regional partners in the MEA-TR region.
The role is of a generalist's scope and will require zooming in and out of all areas that impact the employee experience, amazon's employer value proposition, and business continuity.

We are a passionate group of HR professionals from various backgrounds, that are obsessed with our internal customers, strive to work backwards both intuitively and by leveraging our input mechanisms. We continuously raise the bar, have fun and support each other while doing so.
We are called HR Ops, short for Operations, who are our main customer and focus.
q: 5+ years of HR work within an international, fast-paced, and customer-driven environment experience
Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment
Experience managing small to medium scale projects

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

d: We are looking for a dedicated, detail-oriented, and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our clinical team. The successful candidate will provide direct patient care, assist physicians during consultations and minor procedures, manage clinical workflows, and ensure full compliance with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) healthcare and safety standards.
q: Education: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or Diploma in Nursing (minimum 3 years) from an accredited institution
Licensing: Valid DHA (Dubai Health Authority) Registered Nurse license or active DHA Eligibility Letter (mandatory)
Certifications: Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification (ACLS is an added advantage)
Experience: Minimum of [2-3] years of clinical nursing experience in an outpatient clinic, medical center, or hospital setting (UAE experience preferred)
Skills: Strong clinical assessment skills, proficiency in phlebotomy and IV cannulation, and familiarity with EMR systems
Languages: Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic or other languages is a strong plus

Inventory Management: Monitoring and maintaining inventory levels by conducting regular counts, reconciling discrepancies, and updating records in the warehouse management system (WMS).
li

Receiving and Dispatching: Overseeing the receiving process for incoming shipments, verifying contents against packing slips or purchase orders, and ensuring accurate documentation. Additionally, preparing outgoing shipments, including picking, packing, and labeling items for delivery.
li

Quality Control: Inspecting incoming and outgoing products for damages, defects, or discrepancies and taking appropriate action, such as returning defective items to vendors or initiating corrective measures.
li

Organizing and Storing: Arranging items in the warehouse according to predetermined storage methods, utilizing appropriate equipment and tools such as forklifts or pallet jacks. Ensuring efficient space utilization and maintaining a clean and orderly work environment.
li

Safety Compliance: Adhering to safety protocols and procedures to prevent accidents or injuries. This includes proper handling of hazardous materials, maintaining equipment, and promoting a culture of safety among warehouse staff.
li

Documentation and Reporting: Generating reports related to inventory levels, stock movements, and other relevant metrics using the WMS or other software systems. Maintaining accurate records of transactions and activities.
